purchases.summary:
⚠️ INFORMATION HAZARD ⚠️

The McCollough Effect is a visual pattern that can alter your brain's color perception for MONTHS after just minutes of looking at a specific pattern of colored lines. This is one of the only known perceptual information hazards, where harm is done from mere perception of information alone; the information bypasses all cognitive defenses and affects the brain directly.
